Package com.egradx.auth.security

Class EgradxAuthenticationFilter

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.filter.GenericFilterBean
org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter
com.egradx.auth.security.EgradxAuthenticationFilter
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.Filter, org.springframework.beans.factory.Aware, org.springframework.beans.factory.BeanNameAware, org.springframework.beans.factory.DisposableBean, org.springframework.beans.factory.InitializingBean, org.springframework.context.EnvironmentAware, org.springframework.core.env.EnvironmentCapable, org.springframework.web.context.ServletContextAware
public class EgradxAuthenticationFilter extends org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter
Verifies the caller's bearer token, then — this is the part that matters — re-resolves their current identity/authorities from the database via EgradxPermissionResolver rather than trusting anything the token itself claims about roles or permissions (it doesn't carry any). This is what makes a role reassignment or a permission edit take effect on the caller's very next request, not their next login.

No/invalid/non-Human token → the request passes through unauthenticated; this filter never itself decides a 401/403 — that's @PreAuthorize or whatever's downstream. Populates both SecurityContextHolder (so @PreAuthorize("hasAuthority(...)") works) and EgradxTenantContextAccessor (for finer-grained, in-code checks); both are cleared in a finally block regardless of outcome, since the underlying thread will be reused for other requests.

Only UserType.Human tokens are handled — Service/ Guest tokens are out of scope for this filter.

  • Field Details

    • REJECTED_TOKEN

      public static final String REJECTED_TOKEN
      Set on a request that presented a bearer token which was refused — invalid, expired, or no longer current because the person's sessions were cut off. Lets egradx-auth's own endpoints answer 401 ("sign in again") instead of 403 ("not allowed") for such a request, which is what tells a client to refresh or sign in rather than show a permission error.
